To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
brand gender has a significant impact on consumer brand equity (CBE), which is mediated by brand love and consumer engagement.
brand gender has a significant and positive effect on CBE, which in turn has a significant and negative effect on CBBE.
brand gender influences consumer brand love and brand engagement, and these in turn influence consumer based brand equity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of brand gender in the creation of BL and CBE, which is a relevant topic for both academic and managerial research.
how brand gender impacts BL, CBE and CBBE, and how BL and CBE mediate the relationship between brand identity and CBBE.
the role of brand gender in CBE.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
brand gender has a significant and indirect effect on CBBE, through BL and CEB.
brand gender has a direct and significant effect on CBE and BL, and CBE and BL have a direct and significant impact on CBB.
brand gender identity can be a powerful driver of CBE and BL and thus of CBBE.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
brand gender is a relevant source of brand equity.
the gender positioning of brands is an important source of CBBE, which is mediated through BL and CEB.
the brand gender identity is important to build brand equity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
brands with a clear gender identity are more likely to generate BL and CBE, which in turn positively impact brand awareness, brand association, brand loyalty, and purchase intentions.
brands with strong gender identities will be more likely to generate consumer based brand equity, as they encourage brand love and consumer brand engagement.
brand managers should be aware of the impact of brand gender on CBE and BL.
